item.title: Ford CEO Jim Farley knew the EV pain would be bad, but the ‘punch line’ is a $4.8 billion loss: ‘The customer has spoken’
item.description: The company is pivoting to a “high-volume, affordable end of the market,” meeting customers where they are.

item.title: The affordability crisis is driving unprecedented price cuts in the housing market, Realtor.com says
item.description: “Builders are clearly responding to today’s affordability pressures,” said Realtor.com chief economist Danielle Hale.

item.title: The tech billionaires aren’t just grabbing trophy Florida mansions—they have competing half-billion-dollar megayachts jostling for dock space
item.description: $500,000 annual docking fees and private marinas are all part of the package for Florida’s wealthy seagoers.

item.title: Billionaire founder of Minecraft slams anyone advocating using AI to write code as ‘incompetent or evil’
item.description: Minecraft creator Markus Persson has just issued a warning: That AI is “being forced down our throats” and that leaders behind the push are “evil.”

item.title: Matt Shumer’s viral blog about AI’s looming impact on knowledge workers is based on flawed assumptions
item.description: Shumer misses key distinctions between software development and other professional tasks.

item.title: One of Wall Street’s most feared hedge fund managers on the decline of the dollar: Gold is ‘becoming the reserve asset’
item.description: Greenlight Capital’s David Einhorn, known for the “Einhorn effect” and years of touting gold, says the world‘s central banks don’t love dollars anymore.

item.title: The CEO of Google DeepMind juggles another job as the founder of a multibillion-dollar startup by starting a second workday at 10 p.m.
item.description: While many CEOs may set their alarm clocks for a 5 a.m. wake-up time, Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis has just hit the pillow—oftentimes working until 4 a.m.

item.title: Instagram boss reveals he’s paid $900K per year plus stock worth ‘tens of millions of dollars’ as he denies ‘addiction’ claims
item.description: The plaintiff’s lawyer in a landmark social media addiction trial tried to connect Adam Mosseri’s compensation to Instagram’s policy toward filters.

item.title: Crypto lender BlockFills suspends withdrawals for clients in latest blow to the blockchain sector
item.description: During the digital assets crash of 2022, lenders made similarly protective moves.

item.title: Workday shed $40 billion in value. Founder Aneel Bhusri is back with a $139 million bet he can turn it around
item.description: Workday's compensation plan for its new CEO underscores how much of an uphill fight SaaS companies have in the face of AI.
